say:1:1033442001:1.text: I know. I'm also aware that Eomir used the exclusion edict to corrupt the forest.
say:1:1033442001:1.source_cn: 我知道，我也知道封锁令是伊米尔借以腐化丛林的手段。
say:1:1033442001:1.male: I know. I'm also aware that Eomir used the exclusion edict to corrupt the forest.
say:1:1033442001:1.female: I know. I'm also aware that Eomir used the exclusion edict to corrupt the forest.

say:2:1033442002:1.text: But this doesn't conflict with guarding against outsiders. Yes, Eomir had ulterior motives, but he sure made some good decisions in the past!
say:2:1033442002:1.source_cn: 可这和防范外人并不冲突。伊米尔确实别有用心，但并不意味...
say:2:1033442002:1.male: But this doesn't conflict with guarding against outsiders. Yes, Eomir had ulterior motives, but he sure made some good decisions in the past!
say:2:1033442002:1.female: But this doesn't conflict with guarding against outlanders. Yes, Eomir had ulterior motives, but he sure made some good decisions in the past!

say:3:1033442003:1.text: It's the Thorned Guards' duty to stay alert to the threats the forest would face.
say:3:1033442003:1.source_cn: 时刻警惕丛林面对的威胁，本就是荆棘的职责之一。
say:3:1033442003:1.male: It's the Thorned Guards' duty to stay alert to the threats the forest would face.
say:3:1033442003:1.female: It's the Thorned Guards' duty to stay alert to the threats the forest would face.

say:4:1033442004:1.text: I'll keep my eyes on you, outlander.
say:4:1033442004:1.source_cn: 我会一直注视着你，外乡人。
say:4:1033442004:1.male: I'll keep my eyes on you, outlander.
say:4:1033442004:1.female: I'll keep my eyes on you, outlander.
